prerequisites: A named disposable test tenant and its Public API base URL.
A dedicated test tenant with MEDIA write permission.
A disposable local file and exact allowlisted upload host.
An isolated tracking database and configured transfer encryption key.
media-upload-roundtrip.cleanup: Delete or reconcile the created upload asset after the run, including failure paths.

prerequisites: A disposable webhook endpoint controlled by the test owner.
A short-lived webhook secret stored in local secret configuration.
external-webhook-ping.cleanup: Remove the disposable webhook and revoke its secret after the run.

prerequisites: A dedicated organization created only for integration testing.
An isolated administrator account and explicitly scoped IDP permissions.
A unique policy name that can be read back to resolve its identifier because CreatePolicy returns no response body or resource header.
A database isolated from all other targets.
idp-policy-lifecycle.cleanup: Archive only the policy created by this fixture and verify the dedicated organization is clean.
